name: Haibu Keikaku
source:
Since the school runs short of money, school president decides to close down some small clubs to cut back on expenditure. But he has no idea how to do it, so he asks president of student council, Shogo, about it. Shogo soon comes up with an idea and....

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
由於學校資金短缺，校長決定裁撤部分小社團，以節省開銷。可他不知道該從何下手，便向學生會長翔悟徵求意見。翔悟很快想出一個辦法，隨後……
